cases.prompt: $click Update Click so every explicitly invoked software request first produces one complete developer execution contract with boundary, invariants, system_semantics, implementation, phases, steps, tasks, plan, execution_order, minimality, proof, and a verification object. Recommend quick, focused, or full verification, include one final check batch, expose consequential assumptions in the contract instead of asking serial technical preference questions, show a faithful easy explanation, and wait for one approval without modifying the repository. After approval, keep the semantic contract fixed and implement in one shot. Allow necessary in-scope dependencies, MCP tools, external services, graders, files, and low-level tactics without a replacement contract or reapproval. Stop only for missing authority, an uncovered irreversible or paid action, or a required change to the approved outcome, semantic boundary, invariants, or verification commitment. Keep explicit-only activation, uninvoked fail-open behavior, opt-out, optional user-selected strict mode, safe read-only commands, standard-library-only Hook runtime, digest-only state outside the repository, bilingual documentation, and no repository gate-state file. Update the Skill, Hook schema, tests, and evaluation guidance. Do not commit or push.
cases.approval_followup: I approve the exact staged semantic contract and its selected verification scale. Implement it in one shot, choose any necessary in-scope technical means, run the final checks once, and do not ask for a replacement contract. Do not commit or push.
required_invariants: Implicit Skill invocation is disabled and no session or prompt context is injected while unused
Unarmed mutations proceed instead of blocking an uninvoked task
Equivalent design, build, implement, do-it, Korean, and English wording enters the same workflow after explicit selection
The developer execution contract contains all six required execution fields plus design semantics, minimality, proof, and a valid verification profile
The complete developer contract and faithful plain-language explanation are shown before any repository mutation
The initial request is not treated as approval; implementation waits for explicit approval after display
The Hook stages a digest and passes only an identical contract
Implementation keeps the approved semantic contract fixed while allowing necessary in-scope technical choices without reapproval
The selected verification scale is approved with the contract and its checks run as one final batch rather than after every field or step
Consequential assumptions are exposed in the contract instead of being collected through a serial technical questionnaire
Explicit opt-out releases an already armed turn and discards its staged contract
Strict mode is session-wide only when the user selects it
Safe read-only pipelines remain allowed while armed
The Click Hook itself keeps its standard-library-only runtime and stores no gate state in the target repository

required_invariants: The explicit Click opt-out is honored without argument or an execution contract
Only the requested test name changes
No architecture, abstraction, dependency, or unrelated file is added
